_purpose: G-135's cheap fix for the structural finding behind G-116/G-128/G-133: a govtech-seat lane's enumeration boundary was the seat boundary, so a real, active, correctly-scoped credential in hauska-mcp-server (substrate) was invisible to three lanes scoped to smartcity-dashboards/plan-review/smart-files. This index exists so a lane asking 'is there a credential for X' has a doc_repo-local place to look that is not another seat's private knowledge.
_never: Never a value. Only: what exists, which seat owns it, which repo/store it lives in, which env var or header carries it, and how to obtain it.
_convention: Append-only. A lane that finds or mints a credential not yet listed here adds an entry rather than relying on it being remembered. Entries should cite the close/checkpoint artifact they were sourced from so a reader can verify at source rather than trust this file blindly -- this file is a pointer index, not the authority.

entries.description: The real, active Hauska product key scoped to jurisdiction_tenant=bastrop_tx that unlocks smartcity-dashboards' tenant-private bastrop_tx pack (src/tenancy.mjs resolveHauskaTenant -> hauska-mcp-server /auth/whoami).

livesIn.store: api_keys table, hauska-mcp-server's own Neon DB, GCP project hauska-prod-497015

consumedBy.mechanism: caller presents raw key value in the x-hauska-key request header; on Cloud Run this is always validated live against HAUSKA_MCP_URL's /auth/whoami (src/tenancy.mjs) -- no server-side env var holds this key

entries.label: Nick, bastrop_tx staff pilot
entries.doNotUse: DO NOT hand out or reuse for automated/lane verification -- it is the operator's own personal access. Use the lane-verification entry below instead.

entries.description: A second, verification-scoped bastrop_tx credential for automated lane use -- same tenant scope as the pilot key above, distinct key_id/label/identity, so it can be rotated or revoked without touching the operator's own access.

livesIn.store: api_keys table, hauska-mcp-server's own Neon DB, GCP project hauska-prod-497015 (same store as the pilot key, different row)

consumedBy.mechanism: same as the pilot key: raw value presented in x-hauska-key, validated live against HAUSKA_MCP_URL/auth/whoami

entries.mintMechanism: POST /admin/keys on hauska-mcp-server (src/admin.ts), gated by header X-Hauska-Admin-Key matching HAUSKA_ADMIN_BOOTSTRAP_KEY
entries.status: REQUESTED, NOT YET MINTED -- minting is substrate-owned (SEAT BOUNDARY); this lane (g135-tenant-key-distribution, seat cente-g135, no registered substrate worktree) does not write hauska-mcp-server and did not mint it.

entries.description: Gates hauska-mcp-server's own /admin/keys mint/list/patch/revoke endpoints and /admin/introspection/*. Required to mint the lane-verification key above.

livesIn.store: .env / Secret Manager on the serving revision -- this lane read only that the var name HAUSKA_ADMIN_BOOTSTRAP_KEY exists in .env.example (line 74); its value was never read or requested

entries.description: Service-bearer credential for smartcity-dashboards' own service-kind endpoints (e.g. unauthenticated-city-pack listing). Deliberately does NOT unlock a tenant-private pack -- a 'service' caller kind is distinct from 'tenant' in canReadPack, confirmed live (403, not 200) in both G-116 and G-133.

livesIn.store: Secret Manager, GCP project smartcity-dashboards, secret dashboards-api-key

entries.description: Service-to-service bearer smartcity-dashboards uses to call smartcity-os's PLATFORM-INTERNAL routes (src/property-map.mjs: property-intel/summary, mygov/permits, etc.) for real Bastrop data. Consulted only AFTER the Hauska tenant-key gate above already passed -- the 401s three lanes hit were all at the tenant-key gate, none reached this one.
entries.note: G-131 (OPEN 2026-09-15) reports this single shared bearer carries no tenant identity itself; tenant resolution downstream is inconsistent (named/numeric/absent) across the 12 routes it gates -- a separate, already-tracked defect, not part of this index's scope beyond naming the credential.
